meta.version: AFMAN 36-2905, 24 Mar 2026; PFRA Scoring Charts effective 1 Mar 2026
meta.notes: Every number in this file has been compared against an official source by script, not by reading. THE SCORING TABLES — push-ups, hand-release push-ups, sit-ups, cross-leg reverse crunches, forearm plank, 2-mile run and 20-metre HAMR — were checked cell by cell against the USAF PFRA Scoring Charts (Final, effective 1 Mar 2026): 3,096 cells across nine age groups and both sexes, plus 172 cells of the AFSPECWAR/EOD neutral column and the twelve-row waist-to-height ladder. Zero differences. The charts are pinned in tests/fixtures/pfra-scoring-charts.json and compared by tests/pt-charts.test.ts, so an edit to any number here fails the build. BODY COMPOSITION AND THE TIER 2 ASSESSMENT come from AFMAN 36-2905, 24 March 2026, at meta.sourceUrl: the walk maxima (Table 3.1), the 50/20/15/15 split (para 3.7.1), ratio truncation and its worked example (para 3.15.4.2), the waist procedure (para 3.15.4.5), the Tier 2 trigger (para 3.1.2.1.1), the effect of a met or unmet assessment (para 3.7.2), the walk rules (para 3.7.3), and the taping sites and rounding directions (Attachment 8). Each is pinned by a citing test in tests/pt-score.test.ts. Reading the manual found three errors in the maintainer’s fillable PDF, from which this file was first transcribed, all corrected here: it rounded abdomen, waist and buttocks to the half inch where Attachment 8 says quarter; it passed a body fat result equal to the standard where Table 3.2 says "< 26%" and "< 36%"; and it counted a met assessment as an exemption, warning of a PFRA hold that para 3.9 does not impose. The body fat percentage is read from the published tables at Attachments 9 and 10, which ship as src/data/pt/body-fat-tables.json and carry their own meta block. The DoDI 1308.3 equation is kept only for a measurement off the end of those tables, where the tool says plainly that the figure is not a published one.

data.label: AFMAN 36-2905 — standards effective 1 Mar 2026
chartNotes: Score the highest row you meet or beat. Run and plank times are min:sec.
* marks the minimum passing row. Para 3.7.4: minimums alone cannot reach 75.
Official scores are the ones entered in myFitness on AF Form 4446.

bodyFat.label: Tier 2 body fat assessment
siteNotes: Neck: just below the larynx. Abdomen (male): at the navel, parallel to the floor.
Natural waist (female): narrowest point of the torso. Buttocks (female): widest point of the glutes.
The natural waist is NOT the same site as the waist on the ratio above — measure it separately.
Neck rounds UP to the nearest 1/4 in; abdomen, natural waist and buttocks round DOWN to the nearest 1/4 in (Attachment 8).
